description: This file defines the RenderableFtlMacroCall class, representing a macro call in FreeMarker template language, with methods to construct and access macro call details.

classes.name: RenderableFtlMacroCall
classes.description: Immutable class representing an FTL macro call with a name and parameters.

classes.name: RenderableFtlMacroCallBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing instances of RenderableFtlMacroCall.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to process this macro call.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the macro.

methods.name: getParameters
methods.description: Returns the parameters associated with the macro call.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing a RenderableFtlMacroCall.

methods.name: name (in builder)
methods.description: Sets the macro call's name in the builder.

methods.name: stringParameter
methods.description: Adds a string parameter to the macro call being built.

methods.name: intParameter
methods.description: Adds an integer parameter to the macro call being built.

methods.name: booleanParameter
methods.description: Adds a boolean parameter to the macro call being built.

methods.name: mapParameter
methods.description: Adds a map parameter to the macro call being built.

methods.name: objectParameter
methods.description: Adds an object parameter to the macro call being built.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the RenderableFtlMacroCall instance.
